messages:
Priya Singh: Orchsynth (orchestrator SDK) pinged about deep integration with our Dedicated routing + Gateway. They want a "Certified Orchestrator" listing in the marketplace. Can we sync compatibility gating?
Marco - Partnerships: They claim function-calling tool-contract parity with LangChain Runner. Need to validate call/response schemas, error propagation, and retry semantics.
Rina (Orchsynth PM): We shipped a compliance matrix and sample runner app: https://git.partner/orchsynth/redwood-sample (internal). We also added a connector that uses our step-retry policy.
Jae (Eng): Quick notes from smoke: 1) our function->tool JSON schema requires "tool_id" but their runner emits "name"; 2) their retry semantics surface duplicate side effects if idempotency keys aren't present.
Sam - Integrations: Repro snippet I used:
```
curl -s -X POST https://sandbox.redwood.local/v1/orchestrate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"runner":"orchsynth-v1","task":{"tool":"calendar.create","payload":{"title":"qna"}}}'
```
Sam - Integrations: Result = shell call executed twice when runner retried on transient 502 from gateway. No idempotency-key in payload.
Priya Singh: Risk for customers: duplicated side-effects (calendars, emails). Gating candidate: require idempotency-key propagation or runner opt-in to our at-most-once toolkit.
Rina (Orchsynth PM): We can add idempotency-key mapping on our side and emit tool metadata. ETA to patch sample: 3 business days. Can Redwood provide a helper shim?
Jae (Eng): We can add a lightweight middleware in the gateway that injects X-idempotency if the runner does not provide one, but it will only help for stateless retries (not app-level dedupe). Might be acceptable as interim.
Tess - Marketplace: For listing we need: sample runner app, terraform + helm, perf snapshot (orchestration latency p50/p95), security checklist (SAML/SSO details), and a short runbook on idempotency behavior.
Lina Legal: For a "Certified Orchestrator" badge we need an indemnity clause covering side-effect duplication risks and a support escalation path. I can draft addendum; ETA 2026-06-02.
ci-bot: Integration smoke #9012 started: runner-idempotency-tests.
Marco - Partnerships: Proposal: two-level listing plan: "Preview Orchestrator" if middleware shim applied + runbook; full "Certified Orchestrator" after runner emits tool_id/idempotency keys and passes e2e tests. Marketing prefers a preview listing to align with partner timing.
Priya Singh: Agree with two-stage plan. Action items: Rina -> patch sample to emit tool_id + idempotency within 3 business days; Jae/Sam -> prototype gateway idempotency shim & tests by EOD 2026-05-28; Lina -> draft addendum by 2026-06-02; Tess -> marketplace preview badge copy hold until legal.
Rina (Orchsynth PM): Will prioritize patch and share a PR link when ready.
Sam - Integrations: If shim lands we can run a full e2e (including calendar side-effect sim) in our sandbox and capture p50/p95.
Priya Singh: Ok everyone, tag owners @Rina (Orchsynth PM) @Jae (Eng) @Sam - Integrations @Lina Legal. We'll reconvene after the PRs and CI run. Thanks. :raised_hands:
